skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and interpret lectures and presentations at C1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), equivalent to 6.5-7.5 IELTS.
Effectively take notes during lectures and presentations using various techniques and symbols.
Analyze and evaluate information, identify and solve problems.
Work effectively in groups, express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective approaches.
Participate in discussions, present information logically and coherently.
Demonstrate proficiency in English at C1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), equivalent to 6.5-7.5 IELTS.
Identify and use relevant information sources, develop personal abbreviation systems.
Organize personal study, complete assignments on time.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations.
